answer: Bind every key to one living principal. Each epoch they film a twenty-second clip saying a VRF phrase while showing an issuer-signed ID whose document hash may attach to only one key. A farm of 40 aliases then needs 40 people at about $30 each, or $1,200 per epoch, and the profit from cheap clones falls to a nadir. One operator cannot wear forty faces: a reused hash drops the cluster like a karst sinkhole opening under a field. Deepfake grafts on stolen cards fail a random head-turn plus an NFC passport SOD or mobile-DL nonce, read through the copper security thread only the issuer can mint.
